title: 第5章 崭露头角第6章 烟花三月扬州双龙
lines: 别看王重阳在世的时候吹得凶，给七名不成器的弟子创下了天罡七星北斗阵，就是为了让他们联合起来有比拟顶尖的实力。
在王重阳的计算中，七名一流高手，只要用此阵法，围殴一个顶尖完全不成问题，甚至对上宗师也不落下风。
但是王重阳作为道家迈入宗师境界的人物，还是算漏了一点。
高手之间对阵，讲究的是气、机、势。
天罡七星北斗阵只占了一个势，哪有什么必胜把握。
高手出手，都是不着痕迹，如羚羊挂角。
以七位一流高手的水准，很难在思路上跟上顶尖或者宗师。
守一时可以，但顶尖和宗师总能找到破绽。
施展阵法的是人，不是机器，会有心绪波动和起伏，自然也会露出破绽和漏洞。
这东西就和做题是一样的。
一流高手答题能到90分，顶尖是99，宗师和超绝都是100分。
看似只有10分的差距，但关键在于，一流高手只能止步90。顶尖比一流多了9分的思路和掌握。
宗师就更不用说，满分是因为考卷只有100分。
他甚至可以变着花样变换思路用不同方法解题。
至于超绝，那直接就是出题人级别了。
为什么出这道题，考的是哪些知识点，他们都了然于胸。
题目和考卷，是他们掌握规则的一部分。
如果是七位王重阳级别的高手组成此阵，以自身武学见识打底，的确可以拦住超绝。
可现在只是五位一流，外加两名在二三流晃荡的三代弟子，组成的阵法，就只有一个词——死板。
不懂变通，知其然而不知其所以然。
面对这样的七星北斗阵，江寒手持石剑，运起玄铁剑法。
举重若轻、举轻若重。
沉重清脆的石剑，在江寒手中，却发挥出莫大威力。
轻重刚柔随心所欲，轻灵飘逸。
越是平平无奇的招式，就越难抵挡。
隐约摸到了大道至简的门槛。
刚劲柔劲混而为一，抵挡催动阵法的七人，只觉得胸口积郁了一口闷气。
看似汹涌澎湃的剑招，却附着一股柔力，将他们对抗的力量以精妙手段化解。
看似平平无奇、如清风拂面的招式，却蕴含雷霆之势，让人猝不及防，体内气血翻腾。
只是几合，七人脸颊都盖上了一层红晕，浑身气血躁动，内力也逐渐不受控制。
几人心中无比震撼，眼前自称独孤峰主的江寒，年纪不过二十多，却掌握了一手横行天下的剑术。
一把石剑把他们困的如封似闭，全然使不出半点力气。
这种级别，俨然是顶尖境界。
这若是换做一把上乘重剑，怕不是一开始就结束战斗。
“好了，该结束了。”
江寒话音刚落，催动内力，夹杂内力的一剑，蕴含风雷之势，连带着一股强劲的威压，笼罩在七人头顶，完全击碎了剑阵之势。
全真五子齐齐被雄厚剑法击退，踉跄后退了十步才止住脚步。
两名三代弟子就没那么好运。
李志常直接倒飞出去，跌落在地，嘴角有鲜血溢出。
尹志平最惨，被江寒以石剑牢牢固定在原地。
content_en:
Don't look at Wang Chongyang's fierce boasting when he was still alive. He created the Tiangang Seven-Star Beidou Formation for seven incompetent disciples, just to let them unite to have relatively top strength.
In Wang Chongyang's calculations, as long as seven first-class masters use this formation, it will not be a problem to surround a top one, and they will not be inferior even against a grandmaster.
But Wang Chongyang, as a Taoist who has entered the realm of master, still missed something.
The battle between masters focuses on energy, opportunity and momentum.
The Tiangang Seven-Star Beidou Formation only occupies one position, so there is no guarantee of victory.
A master's attack will leave no trace, like an antelope hanging its horns.
With the level of seven first-class masters, it is difficult to keep up with the top or masters in terms of thinking.
It's okay to hold on for a while, but top players and masters can always find flaws.
The person who performs the formation is a human being, not a machine. There will be mood swings and ups and downs, and flaws and loopholes will naturally be exposed.
This thing is the same as doing a question.
A first-class expert can answer a question with a score of 90, the top is 99, and a master and a master can both score 100.
It seems that the difference is only 10 points, but the key is that top players can only stop at 90. The top level has 9 points more ideas and mastery than the first level.
Not to mention Grandmaster, the perfect score is because the test paper only has 100 points.
He can even change his mind and use different methods to solve problems.
As for transcendence, it is directly at the level of the question maker.
They all knew why this question was asked and what knowledge points were tested.
Questions and test papers are part of the rules they master.
If seven Wang Chongyang-level masters formed this formation and used their own martial arts knowledge as a base, they could indeed stop Chao Jue.
But now there are only five first-class people, plus two third-generation disciples who are wandering in the second and third classes. The formation formed can only be described in one word - rigid.
If you don't know how to adapt, you know it but don't know why.
Facing such a seven-star Beidou formation, Jiang Han held a stone sword and used the black iron sword technique.
Lift a heavy weight as if it were light, and lift a light weight as if it were heavy.
The heavy and crisp stone sword exerted great power in Jiang Han's hands.
Light, heavy, hard and soft as you please, light and elegant.
The more ordinary the move is, the harder it is to resist.
I vaguely touched the threshold of the great road to simplicity.
Strength and softness blended into one, resisting the seven people who urged the formation, and only felt a suffocation in the chest.
The seemingly turbulent sword moves were actually accompanied by a soft force, which resolved the power of their confrontation with subtle means.
The moves may seem ordinary, like the breeze blowing on the face, but they contain the power of thunder, catching people off guard and causing the blood and energy in their bodies to surge.
After just a few moments, the seven people's cheeks were covered with a layer of blush, their blood and energy were restless, and their internal energy was gradually out of control.
Several people were extremely shocked. In front of them, Jiang Han, who claimed to be the master of Dugu Peak, was only in his twenties, but he had mastered the world-famous swordsmanship.
A stone sword trapped them so tightly that they couldn't use any strength at all.
This level is like the top realm.
If this were replaced by a superior heavy sword, the battle might not end right from the start.
"Okay, it's time to end."
As soon as Jiang Han finished speaking, he activated his internal energy. The sword mixed with the internal energy contained the power of wind and thunder, and along with it, a strong coercion enveloped the heads of the seven people, completely shattering the sword formation.
The five Quanzhen disciples were all repelled by the powerful swordsmanship and staggered back ten steps before stopping.
Two third-generation disciples were not so lucky.
Li Zhichang flew out directly and fell to the ground, with blood spilling from the corner of his mouth.
Yin Zhiping was the worst, being held firmly in place by Jiang Han with his stone sword.
